stem_book: Two cubes of masses m₁ and m₂ lie on frictionless slopes of a block A which rests on a horizontal table. The cubes are connected by a string which passes over a pulley as shown in figure (m₂ on the upper face inclined at β, sloping down towards the pulley; m₁ on the outer face inclined at α). If a be the horizontal acceleration (towards the pulley side, as shown) to which the whole system (block + masses) is subjected, so that m₁ and m₂ do not move relative to A, then find a.
key: a = [(m₁ sinα + m₂ sinβ)/(m₁ cosα + m₂ cosβ)] g
derived: a = g(m₁ sinα + m₂ sinβ)/(m₁ cosα + m₂ cosβ)
correct_answer: a = g(m₁ sinα + m₂ sinβ)/(m₁ cosα + m₂ cosβ)
reason: Symbolic answer, no options; manifest stem paraphrased.
work: in A's frame: m₁: T = m₁(g sinα − a cosα) ; m₂: T = m₂(a cosβ − g sinβ) → a = g(m₁ sinα + m₂ sinβ)/(m₁ cosα + m₂ cosβ)
